work:
Room drafts — bridge: storm horizon over a console band. Wet lab: low view through looping hoses. Dry lab: cool monitor grid from behind a chair. Mess hall: round table at seated height. Medical bay: white clearing beside an examination bed. Crew quarters: eight doors in tight perspective. Editing room: cool monitor grid from behind a chair. Engineering workshop: low view through looping service lines.

People drafts — thomas_blake: reclining wedge, open palm, direct gaze. sarah_morgan: upright column, hands behind back, gaze past the viewer. maya_chen: forward oval, raised notebook, lowered gaze. daniel_reyes: hunched square, wiping hand, sideways glance. olivia_hart: forward oval, raised clipboard, lowered gaze. lucas_weber: reclining wedge, open palm, direct gaze.

First pass, comparing all 28 room pairs and all 15 portrait pairs. Wet lab and engineering workshop shared eight axes and the same silhouette of hoses, so the workshop moved overhead to a tall pegboard grid with a green vise. Dry lab and editing room shared seven axes and the same monitor wall, so the editing room gained a steep view across a diagonal bench and a red lamp pool. Maya and Olivia shared seven axes and the same inward pose, so Olivia became a seated arc with folded hands and a gaze directed away. Thomas and Lucas shared six axes and the same conversational pose, so Lucas turned sideways in a tight crop, with his camera near his cheek and his eyes lifted.

Second pass. The closest room pairs share two axes each. Bridge and engineering workshop share mid brightness and order. Wet lab and engineering workshop share hard light and mid brightness. Dry lab and crew quarters share darkness and order. Dry lab and engineering workshop share a grid and order. Mess hall and editing room share layered depth and lived-in density. Crew quarters and engineering workshop share hard light and order. Their thumbnail anchors are distinct: storm horizon, hose loops, monitor bank, round table, white infirmary floor, receding doors, red diagonal bench, and tall pegboard.

The closest portrait pairs share one axis each. Thomas and Daniel share a waist-up crop. Thomas and Olivia share soft light. Sarah and Daniel share hard light. Sarah and Olivia share a hip-up crop. Maya and Lucas share the act of holding an object. Their outlines still read as wedge, column, oval, square, arc, and diagonal. Use broken ink contours and granulating washes throughout, with the strongest edges reserved for each room’s anchor or each person’s signature gesture.

rooms.description: A continuous strip of storm windows backlights a low, bolted console. Blue radar and navigation screens sit below the slanted sea horizon. At one end, a weather display overlooks the log station, radio handset, and noticeboard.

From just above the gritty anti-slip deck, look through teal hose loops toward a bolted steel bench. A hard work light catches beads on the sampling manifold, clamped sample bottles, and the squat pumps beneath.
rooms.feeling: Close, humid, and loud enough to raise your voice.

rooms.description: Over a seated operator’s shadowed shoulder, a square bank of monitors fills the wall with muted violet plots. Two keyboards line up on the bolted desk beneath clipped sheets of tiny graphs. Vents disappear into shadow.
rooms.feeling: Quiet enough to hear the ventilation.

rooms.description: At seated height, a round pedestal table fills the foreground with mismatched mugs and a coffee pot. Warm ceiling and galley light soften its scuffed orange rim. A refrigerator and curling noticeboard papers sit beyond.
rooms.feeling: Familiar warmth, with the morning routine half finished.

rooms.description: From the back corner, a broad pool of ceiling light falls across bare pale vinyl. A narrow examination bed hugs one wall beneath latched cabinets. A diagnostic workstation and a report desk occupy opposite corners.
rooms.feeling: Orderly and private, with little to distract the eye.

rooms.description: From the threshold, four narrow cabin doors per side recede to a blank bulkhead. Yellow light from the nearest ajar door cuts across the dark passage, picking out vertical jambs, rubbed latches, and a handrail.
rooms.feeling: Private even in the shared passage.

rooms.description: From high above one corner, a diagonal bench leads from charging bricks and a camera cage to a laptop and two dim monitors. A red-shaded lamp pools over coiled headphones and shot-list sheets pinned above old chart clips.

Look down a tall pegboard grid of sockets and spanners toward a green vise on a bolted bench. Hard ceiling strips pick out stacked parts bins, the maintenance terminal, a clipped diagram, and a rugged multimeter.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper into a tailored navy jacket. He leans back with one palm open at chest height, eyes on the viewer. Soft light catches his square jaw, neatly parted silvering hair, and faint smile.
people.feeling: Personable, with a quick expectation of an answer.

people.description: Tall and narrow, she stands straight in a charcoal ship’s uniform, elbows tucked and hands behind her back. Hard side light picks out a long face, clipped grey hair, and eyes fixed just past the viewer.
people.feeling: Steady, with the next words carefully weighed.

people.description: A short, solid build and rounded shoulders fill the bust crop. She leans over a pocket notebook held high against her teal fleece and open overshirt. Screen glow catches her round cheeks, tired eyes, and short curls.
people.feeling: Approachable and intent, even through fatigue.

people.description: Thick forearms and hunched shoulders square off his grease-marked olive coveralls. He wipes his knuckles with a rag while glancing sideways. Hard overhead light picks out a broad nose, salt stubble, and close-shaved hair.
people.feeling: Worn out and ready to get back to work.

people.description: Slight and long-limbed, she sits with her shoulders curving over hands folded in her lap. Soft light settles on a heart-shaped face, a straight auburn bob, and loose violet scrubs. Her eyes rest to one side.
people.feeling: Attentive enough to let a silence stand.

people.description: Close in on a wiry shoulder and an angled, freckled face. He turns sideways, looking up with one eyebrow lifted, a compact camera in hand beside his cheek. Backlight catches his tousled blond hair and fitted rust-orange collar.
people.feeling: Curious, already halfway into a follow-up question.
